text: The Delver's Journey is a seasonal rewards track for delves, found in the Journeys tab of the Adventure Guide. Delver's Journey progress is granted at the end of Bountiful Delves, as well as from the quest The Key to Success. For every 4,200 Delver's Journey progress, a new reward is unlocked. There are 10 total unlocks per season—mostly cosmetics and other items. Current Delver's Journey progress can be checked with the following macro: /run local t=C_MajorFactions.GetMajorFactionRenownInfo(C_DelvesUI.GetDelvesFactionForSeason());print("Journey Stage:",t.renownLevel,"Progress:",t.renownReputationEarned,"/",t.renownLevelThreshold)

Delver's Dirigible Schematic: Lantern Wing unlocks the Lantern Wing customization for the Delver's Dirigible. It is available for purchase from Reno Jackson for 2,600 Resonance Crystals. During The War Within Season 1, after earning a total of 4,200 Delver's Journey progress, this item was purchasable from Reno Jackson for 10 Resonance Crystals.

Delver's Bounty is an item that, after being used, will cause a Hidden Trove to appear at the end of the next completed tier 4 or higher delve. Starting in The War Within Season 3, players are required to reach step 2 of the Delver's Journey before they start dropping. This map has a chance to drop from a Bountiful Heavy Trunk or from the Ky'veza's Etheric Cache that Nexus-Princess Ky'veza drops during a delve invasion. Players can force a nemesis spawn by using the Shrieking Quartz at the respawn stone inside a delve. At Tier 8, the Hidden Trove contains: * 100 Resonance Crystals * 200 Undercoin * 75 Valorstones * Hero 1 equipment * 4x Gilded Ethereal Crest Higher tiers will reward more gil
